answer: Before the kiln cools the thrower walks to the glazehouse and glazes the lip and fires the kiln while the pots dry. The throwing is vouched by Fir beater drumcaller drumworks ledger: a ledger beater drumcallers stretch twice drumworks shell tallies hold. The wander stamps the seal, the saffron fires the ware, the fable trims the foot. A counterfeit urn is caught by 71837 counterfeit urns and 71837 counterfeit vases counted twice at the market stall.
